
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/MikeZhang/p/19223581/mod_rnnoise20251114" title="发布于 2025-11-14 21:55">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">FreeSWITCH使用RNNoise进行实时通话降噪</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div>操作系统：Debian 12.5_x64</div>
<div>FreeSWITCH版本： 1.10.11</div>
<div>rnnoise版本：0.2</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div>从事FreeSWITCH相关工作，大概率会遇到静音检测和降噪的事情，之前整理过vad相关的内容：</div>
<div><a href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/sxbhD20ojzQI_LJlkla0vA" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/sxbhD20ojzQI_LJlkla0vA</a></div>
<div>
<div>今天整理下FreeSWITCH使用RNNoise实现实时音频降噪的笔记，并提供示例代码（如需商业使用请参考文章自行实现)。</div>
<div>我将从以下几个方面展开：</div>
<div>
<ul>
<li>模块整体结构介绍</li>
<li>模块使用说明及示例</li>
<li>模块编译及加载</li>
<li>具体实现</li>
<li>配套资源下载</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>关于如何使用RNNoise库进行音频降噪，可参考我之前的笔记：</div>
<div><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/MikeZhang/p/19181243/rnnoise20251031" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/MikeZhang/p/19181243/rnnoise20251031</a></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>本文对应的源码及资源，可从文末提供的渠道获取。</div>
<div>
<h1 id="U3cx-1763127034743">一、模块说明</h1>
<div>模块名称： mod_rnnoise</div>
<div>整体结构如下：</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114213106027-1352420848.png" alt="fb068aeeadc261fc7a3056e10920aaa9" width="805" height="393" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;说明：</p>
</div>
<div>
<div>1）mod_rnnoise模块获取channel的原始音频；</div>
<div>2）mod_rnnoise模块将获取到的原始音频转换成RNNoise库适配的48khz的音频，然后使用RNNoise进行降噪；</div>
<div>3）mod_rnnoise模块接收降噪后的音频，执行采样率转换（如有需要），回传给channel进行覆盖；</div>
<h1 id="CTCy-1763127089479">二、模块使用</h1>
<h2 id="pWOi-1763127089483">1、API命令说明</h2>
<div>【降噪命令】</div>
<div>uuid_rnnoise</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>【命令格式】</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>uuid_rnnoise &lt;uuid&gt; start|stop read|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">write</span></pre>
</div>
<div>【字段说明】</div>
<div>uuid ： 需要进行降噪的channel uuid</div>
<div>start|stop ： 开始降噪或结束降噪</div>
<div>read|write ： 降噪方向（相对于channel），读取（收音）或者写入（放音）</div>
<h2 id="AbMw-1763127122320">2、事件说明</h2>
<div>基于自定义事件实现mod_rnnoise的事件，关于如何实现自定义事件，可参考如下文章：</div>
<div><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/MikeZhang/p/gen_freeswitch_event_20160927.html" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/MikeZhang/p/gen_freeswitch_event_20160927.html</a></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>有两个事件：</div>
<div>mod_rnnoise::start 降噪开始事件</div>
<div>mod_rnnoise::stop 降噪结束事件</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>有两个自定义字段：</div>
<div>channel_uuid 执行降噪的channel uuid</div>
<div>nr_direction 降噪的方向(read | write)</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>1）mod_rnnoise::start 事件</strong></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>事件示例如下：</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Event-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Subclass: mod_rnnoise::start
Event</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Name: CUSTOM
Core</span>-UUID: 1ffa45ca-23e6-4a2c-b7aa-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">684160c2cd47
FreeSWITCH</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Hostname: host72
FreeSWITCH</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Switchname: fs72
FreeSWITCH</span>-IPv4: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">137.72</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
FreeSWITCH</span>-IPv6: ::<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Event</span>-Date-Local: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2025</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">01</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">17</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Event</span>-Date-GMT: Fri, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">14</span> Nov <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2025</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">06</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">17</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GMT
Event</span>-Date-Timestamp: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1763100737378843</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Event</span>-Calling-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">File: mod_rnnoise.c
Event</span>-Calling-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Function: do_start
Event</span>-Calling-Line-Number: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">270</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Event</span>-Sequence: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">37486</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
channel_uuid: f764246a</span>-dacb-4fe1-ad47-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">fafdb9c0b4c1
nr_direction: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">write</span></pre>
</div>
<div><strong>2）mod_rnnoise::stop事件</strong></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>事件示例如下：</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Event-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Subclass: mod_rnnoise::stop

FreeSWITCH</span>-IPv6: ::<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Event</span>-Date-Local: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2025</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">01</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">28</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

</div>
<div>运行效果如下：</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114213251469-614815353.png" alt="579b467ad94f310a1c091e1c63477d66" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="Pohe-1763127182911">3、使用示例</h2>
<div>为了演示方便，这里使用echo呼叫进行测试，使用uuid_record命令进行双声道录音，使用Audacity&nbsp;软件查看音频波形。</div>
<div>关于uuid_record录音可参考如下文章：</div>
<div><a href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/9wNFyWk-sprHOCBK9O7aGA" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/9wNFyWk-sprHOCBK9O7aGA</a></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div>关于Audacity&nbsp;软件的使用可参考如下文章：</div>
<div><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/MikeZhang/p/audacity2022022.html" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/MikeZhang/p/audacity2022022.html</a></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>1）模拟呼叫</strong></div>
<div>命令如下：</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> originate user/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1010</span> &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114213419566-773205351.png" alt="a39d25a681ad4c0d1f1c0425a91c2ea0" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>2）执行降噪</strong></p>
<p><span>这里为了方便对比，使用write方向降噪。</span></p>
<p><span>命令如下：</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>uuid_rnnoise&nbsp;81d3b389-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1161</span>-41e9-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9287</span>-ee0ec0bacceb start <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">write</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span>降噪效果可通过耳机等音频播放设备实时体验。</span></p>
<p><strong>3）执行录音</strong></p>
<p><span>命令如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>uuid_record&nbsp;81d3b389-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1161</span>-41e9-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9287</span>-ee0ec0bacceb start /tmp/t123.wav</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>4）关闭降噪</strong></p>
<p><span>命令如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>uuid_rnnoise&nbsp;81d3b389-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1161</span>-41e9-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9287</span>-ee0ec0bacceb stop <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">write</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span>此时录音仍在继续。</span></p>
<p><strong>5）停止录音</strong></p>
<p><span>命令如下：</span></p>
</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>uuid_record&nbsp;81d3b389-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1161</span>-41e9-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9287</span>-ee0ec0bacceb stop /tmp/t123.wav</pre>
</div>
<p>运行效果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114213626200-1352780623.png" alt="b2d2ece8a43b8e8b869490bd4a408a4c" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>从上图可以看出，使用rnnoise进行实时降噪，背景噪音降噪明显。</p>
<p><span>配套的录音文件可从文末提供的渠道获取。</span></p>
<h1><span><span>三、模块编译</span></span></h1>
<h2><span><span>1、依赖库说明</span></span></h2>
<p><span>这里使用rnnoise库，可参考我之前的文章：</span></p>
<p><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/MikeZhang/p/19181243/rnnoise20251031" target="_blank"><span>https://www.cnblogs.com/MikeZhang/p/19181243/rnnoise20251031</span></a><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzU4MDU1NzQ1MA==&amp;mid=2247485811&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=22fb2d727e8b7e046331e42a91b410c8&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow"><br></a></p>
<h2>2、复制模块代码到freeswitch目录</h2>
<p><span>复制源码到freeswitch目录：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cp</span>&nbsp;mod_rnnoise /root/src/freeswitch-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.10</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11</span>.-release/src/mod/applications/ -r</pre>
</div>
<h2>3、添加FreeSWITCH编译配置项</h2>
<p><span>1）添加模块编译项</span></p>
<p><span>文件：源码根目录的modules.conf文件</span></p>
<p><span>添加如下代码：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>applications/mod_rnnoise</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114213815475-1180658703.png" alt="817b68b7e0cb32d9f81cee8e9607bcc7" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>2）添加模块自动生成Makefile</span></p>
<p><span>文件： &nbsp;源码根目录的configure.ac文件</span></p>
<p><span>添加如下代码：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>src/mod/applications/mod_rnnoise/Makefile</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114213919756-909897516.png" alt="5d8bfee769562ad800c7fcfda7208831" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>4、重新编译FreeSWITCH</h2>
<p><span>源码目录执行如下命令：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>autoreconf -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">fiv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> clean
.</span>/devel-bootstrap.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span> &amp;&amp; ./configure &amp;&amp; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span> &amp;&amp; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span></pre>
</div>
<div>说明：</div>
<div>1）会生成Makefile文件；</div>
<div>2）会静态编译mod_rnnoise模块；</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114214034761-377202095.png" alt="c9addd8d6d61bd09de4aca90c0b9b1b2" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>5、加载mod_rnnoise模块</h2>
<p><span>编辑 conf/autoload_configs/modules.conf.xml 文件，添加如下内容：</span></p>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;load&nbsp;module=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mod_rnnoise</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>/&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114214106766-1383001659.png" alt="f348328210be4587568668ee5213af85" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;重启FreeSWITCH或执行重新load操作：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>reload&nbsp;mod_rnnoise</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114214134927-1124517810.png" alt="f4558891b350e5cd47ba0f376d5eba03" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span>如果加载不报错，则添加mod_rnnoise模块成功。</span></p>
<h1><span><span>四、具体实现</span></span></h1>
<p><span>说明：</span></p>
<p><strong>本文主要讨论技术，配套资源为示例代码，如需商业使用，请参考文章自行实现。</strong></p>
<p><span>这里描述下实现的部分技术关键点，更多内容可从文末提供的渠道获取。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>1、采样率转换</span></span></h2>
<p><span>当前使用的rnnoise库所使用的音频采样率是48khz，而在FreeSWITCH中，采样率可能是8khz（比如PCMA、PCMU编码），这就涉及采样率转换的情况。</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114214212097-937644131.png" alt="9ee10ee7acd30f25c71122ac51174c98" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span>这里使用简单的线性插值方式进行采样率转换。</span></p>
<p><span>示例代码如下：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114214226553-1565853609.png" alt="b04a4b792038ac147373aafb0853fbd3" loading="lazy"></p>
<div>完整源码可从如下渠道获取：</div>
<div>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复&nbsp;20251114&nbsp;获取。&nbsp;</div>
<h2><span><span>2、降噪功能</span></span></h2>
<p><span>降噪功能使用RNNoise库的rnnoise_process_frame函数实现，具体如下（以8khz为例）：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114214305870-852552336.png" alt="d5a81aea8667987a1bdbe64e9ac70d6b" loading="lazy"></p>
<div>完整源码可从如下渠道获取：</div>
<div>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复&nbsp;20251114&nbsp;获取。&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<h1 id="9ypK-1763127903115">五、资源下载</h1>
<div>本文相关资源及示例代码，可从如下渠道获取：</div>
<div>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复&nbsp;20251114&nbsp;获取。</div>
</div>

<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251114214537791-1483565182.png" alt="90dd27fc47fde287997e5f2e810e4ab6" loading="lazy"></p>
</div>
<div>
<div>【文件说明】</div>
<div>mod_rnnoise_src.tar.gz ： mod_rnnoise源代码</div>
<div>mod_rnnoise_srcbin.tar.gz ： mod_rnnoise源代码（带预编译的so文件，路径为mod_rnnoise.libs\）</div>
<div>mod_rnnoise_bin_debian12.tar.gz : debian12_x64环境下预编译二进制（so文件）</div>
<div>t123.wav ： 带降噪效果的录音文件</div>
